context_for_next_testing_agent: The '3 Highest Impact Actions' section is implemented in ArthMitraReport.js (lines 1878-2114). It derives data from tenFactorData (10-Factor analysis) and opportunityData (opportunity analyzer). Priority logic: 1) Insurance gaps (0 score) = CRITICAL (Orange), 2) Low-performing components (<40%) = HIGH (Green), 3) Medium performers (40-70%) = MEDIUM (Blue). The section is positioned between Financial Opportunity Analyzer (section 3) and 10-Factor Financial Health Analysis (section 4).
